no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not presented to an Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the crofelemer (MYTESI) NDA. The Cross-Discipline Team Leader review (L495), Medical Review (L1118: "No advisory committee meeting of Crofelemer was conducted."), and Summary Review (L91) all state no AC was held; instead the application was presented at an internal CDER Center Director Briefing on August 6, 2012. Because no advisory committee was convened, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
